parameterMigrations.note: Claude Fable 5.1 uses always-on adaptive thinking. Remove manual thinking budgets and control depth with output_config.effort.

notes: tool_choice types any and tool are unsupported and return HTTP 400; auto and none remain supported.
thinking type disabled is unsupported; adaptive thinking is always on.
Non-default temperature, top_p, and top_k values return HTTP 400.
Per-message effort is beta and can change effort mid-conversation without invalidating prompt caching.
Turn-scoped system messages and thinking.display=updates are beta.
Thinking blocks produced by Claude Fable 5.1 cannot be consumed by earlier Claude models.
Claude Fable 5.1 binds preserved thinking blocks to the preceding conversation prefix; editing earlier turns can invalidate later thinking blocks.
Parallel tool use is supported, although Anthropic notes that Fable 5.1 may issue fewer parallel calls in long agent loops unless independent work is explicit.
Computer use is supported, including computer_toolset_20260801 and the earlier computer_20251124 compatibility path.

tokenizerNotes: Uses the same tokenizer as Claude Fable 5, introduced with Claude Opus 4.7.
